text.p: The European Commission said on Wednesday it was starting a routine probe into a proposed joint-venture between Coca-Cola Co and Carlsberg A/S of Denmark.
Coca-Cola announced last month the creation of the venture called Coca-Cola Nordic Beverages A/S (CCNB) in which it would hold a 49 percent stake.

CCNB would own interests in various entities in the Nordic region starting with Denmark and Sweden, the Commission said in a notice. The company would have the rights to produce, distribute, market and sell Coca-Cola products and other non-alcoholic beverages, it addded.
The Commission said the deal was submitted for clearance on March 25 under the EU's merger rules which ban creation or strengthening of dominant positions.

It has a month from that date to clear the operation or start a full investigation if it is concerned about its effect on fair competition. A Coca-Cola spokesman said in March that EU regulatory approval could take a few months.

The Commission cleared in January Coca-Cola's acquisition of British bottler CCSB which it formerly jointly controlled with Cadbury Schweppes Public Ltd Co despite CCSB's dominance of the British cola market. -- Amelia Torres 322 2876841
